extracted.name: Lightly Battered Cauliflower and Cheese
ingredient_lines: 16 ounces La Croix lemon sparkling water
As needed oil to deep fry in
instruction_lines: Microwave the cauliflower for 5 minutes on high. Heat the oil. Mix the ingredients for the batter. If using the option for a thicker crunchier batter, then do this part next. Mix cornstarch all purpose flour, and seasoned salt. Add the cauliflower and lightly coat then dip into the batter mix. Fry till cauliflower is done to your likeness.
When the whole lot of cauliflower is fried add the cheese. Serve I hope you enjoy!!!!! My granddaughters wanted it all. They wanted more the next day.
